questions.q: What did the wheels look like in Ezekiel's vision?
questions.evidence: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel

questions.q: The living creatures had the face of a man, a lion, an ox and what?
questions.evidence: the four of them also had the face of an eagle

questions.q: When Ezekiel ate the scroll, how did it taste in his mouth?
questions.evidence: and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth

questions.q: Whom does Ezekiel 34 condemn for feeding themselves?
questions.evidence: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and tell them, even to the shepherds, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves

questions.q: What will God take out of their flesh, giving them a heart of flesh?
questions.evidence: I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh

questions.q: Which three righteous men does Yahweh name in Ezekiel 14?
questions.evidence: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord Yahweh

questions.q: "The soul who sins," Ezekiel says, "he shall" what?
questions.evidence: The soul who sins, he shall die

questions.q: What did Yahweh take from Ezekiel as a sign to the people?
questions.evidence: and at evening my wife died

questions.q: What did Yahweh set Ezekiel to be for the house of Israel?
questions.evidence: So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel

questions.q: Whom does Yahweh say he will set up as the one shepherd over his people?
questions.evidence: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David

questions.q: What was the valley Ezekiel was set down in full of?
questions.evidence: and it was full of bones

questions.q: What did Ezekiel join together to show Judah and Israel made one?
questions.evidence: and join them for you to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand

questions.q: What flowed out from under the threshold of the temple, eastward?
questions.evidence: and behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward

questions.q: What will the city's name be from that day?
questions.evidence: It shall be eighteen thousand reeds around: and the name of the city from that day shall be, Yahweh is there
